title: The readiness check result, the title-set task, the trigger and the ACE status field are not specified for rwb-treatment
source: Legacy RWB-E3-013 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md lines 2163 to 2260); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.13 and A2.14; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1, T4 DEEDINLIEU and SETTLEMENT and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-SET-22, R-DIL-01, R-DIL-02, R-DIL-04, R-DIL-05 and R-DIL-06; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 5, 11 and 13; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-03, DP-05, DP-13 and DP-19
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC4; 8 Business rules; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.4; 12.7; 13 Solution plan; 14 Validation and messages
description: One combined row for the encumbrance and eligibility check. (1) The result has no field anywhere: TSD S2 T3.1 gives treatment DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033 and none of them is an encumbrance, registration, title-set, hold or check-time field, FSD S2 A2.13 has no field catalog, and the legacy data table names the view fields only as ranges DF-ACE-091 to DF-ACE-098, DF-ACE-196 to DF-ACE-207 and DF-ACE-208 to DF-ACE-219. (2) The condition of R-DIL-02 and R-DIL-04 is encumbrance_status, and no named field of v_ace_collateral or v_ace_collateral_detail carries it, so whether the status is a column of the ACE read or is computed from lien_rank and register_date is unstated. (3) The legacy story lists one endpoint, GET /api/recovery/v1/treatments/{treatmentId}, and no operation starts, re-runs or reads a check of its own, although the check runs unattended on a route event. (4) R-SET-22 says 'raise a task to re-create the title set before release' with a 5 working-day clock, and no source states who raises the task or on which call type: the connection matrix of Architecture v5 slide 13 gives rwb-treatment no call to rwb-case, whose the task, queue and timer rows are. (5) No source states how the case reaches EARLY_READINESS_CHECK, ENCUMBRANCE_BLOCKED, VALUATION_ORDERED or COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED from a stage: the legacy story moved recovery_case.status in one schema and the target gives the case and its CMMN state to rwb-case. (6) No source fixes the decision code a readiness event carries to the decision record, and no source gives a message text for a blocked and held route. (7) Whether the three views are read directly by rwb-treatment or through the contract read of rwb-source-data is not stated for this story: DP-05 allows both and the architecture says the recovery.v_ace_* views are read only by rwb-source-data.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (treatment fields DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033, no encumbrance, registration or title field); TSD S2 v2 T4 DEEDINLIEU (R-DIL-01 ROUTE_APPROVED_DIL to EARLY_READINESS_CHECK, R-DIL-02 and R-DIL-04 on encumbrance_status, R-DIL-05, R-DIL-06) and SETTLEMENT (R-SET-22 COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED on TITLE_DOCUMENTS_MISSING); TSD S2 v2 T-A.1 (API-S2-001 to API-S2-004 only, none of them a readiness operation); legacy RWB-E3-013 data table ('v_ace_collateral | collateral_no, asset_key, account_key, collateral_value, collateral_type, register_date and 2 more | DF-ACE-091 to DF-ACE-098', 'v_ace_collateral_detail | asset_key, title_doc_no, plot_no, area_text, province, lien_rank and 6 more | DF-ACE-196 to DF-ACE-207') and acceptance criteria AC2 and AC3 ('Then raise a task to re-create the title set before release', 'Then the case moves to EARLY_READINESS_CHECK'); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-SET-22 ('the Workbench document hub, CCMS | 5 working days') and row R-DIL-04 ('CCMS, Land Office | 10 working days'); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 13 row 'S2 Treatment' (no P3 cell, T to P7, P5 and P8, N to ACE Common) and slide 11 (own schema 'state + decision record', outbox to Kafka)
area: Contract and data: readiness result, trigger and read, task ownership, ACE status field
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the P3 owner of the case contract, the P1 owner of the ACE read and the owner of the local decision-record library
proposed: Apply the working read of ASM-B2-S2-008-1, ASM-B2-S2-008-2 and ASM-B2-S2-008-3 with RWB-S2-E3013-CON and RWB-S2-E3013-APP: the readiness answer is an optional section of the treatment read of RWB-S2-E3001-CON, the encumbrance and title statuses are values of the ACE read and never a column of rwb_treatment and never a derivation in code, the title-set task is raised by the parent CaseWorkflow on the reported request with the 5 working-day clock of R-SET-22, the case states are moved by the parent, and the decision code is the rule ID and version the evaluated package returned. Confirm the view grant and the encumbrance column name with the P1 owner and the task path with the P3 owner at the wave 2 contract freeze.

title: The published shape of the readiness section, of the title-set task request and of the view column contract has no source
source: Legacy RWB-E3-013 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md lines 2163 to 2260); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.13; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1 and T-A.1 to T-A.2; Template and Rules v1 R7.2 s12 and R5.5 DP-05
section: 3 Preconditions; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC6; 9 State transitions; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.7; 12.8; 13 Solution plan
description: A contract row with nothing to copy. (1) No source names a readiness resource, a readiness section or a readiness element, so the section name, its ten properties and the split between stored, read and computed properties are unpublished. (2) No source states whether the check answer is served inside the treatment read, on a sub-path of its own or through a separate read, and the TSD endpoint inventory stops at the four treatment operations. (3) No source names the element in which the stage reports a title-set task to the case, so the request name, its properties, its reason code and the way the 5 working-day clock travels are unpublished. (4) The three views are given only by field ranges, and the two statuses the rules condition on carry no column name, so the read-only column contract cannot be copied from a source. (5) No source gives the error answers of a read that carries an optional section, and the legacy message table names six identifiers of the module without mapping them to status codes.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (no readiness element and no encumbrance field) and T-A.1 (four treatment operations, no readiness read); FSD S2 v3 A2.13 (main success flow AC-S2-013-01 with no field catalog and no element) and A2.13.3.1 (rules R-SET-22, R-DIL-01 and R-DIL-04 only); legacy RWB-E3-013 endpoints table ('GET | /api/recovery/v1/treatments/{treatmentId} | Treatment and offer R') and validation table (MSG-S2-001, MSG-S2-002, MSG-S2-003, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002, MSG-P7-003 with no status code); Template and Rules v1 R7.2 s12 (tables 12.1 to 12.9) and R5.5 DP-05
area: Contract: readiness section, task request element, view column contract, error set
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-treatment tech lead, the P3 owner of the case contract and the P1 owner of the ACE read
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S2-008-3 as the rwb-treatment contract v1: the readiness section as an optional addition to the answer of GET /treatments/{treatmentId} at the same major version with checkType, encumbranceStatus, registrationStatus, titleSetStatus, checkedAt, ruleId, ruleVersion, holdUntil, collateralNo and assetKey; TitleSetTaskRequest as an element of the stage outcome with R-SET-22, its version, the 5 working-day clock and the reason code; the three view ranges marked read only; and 401, 403 with MSG-P4-002, 404, 422 with MSG-GEN-001 and 503 for the errors. Confirm the section with the owner of RWB-S2-E3001-CON and the request with the P3 owner at the wave 2 contract freeze.
